findings.current: Inform Donghu Stronghold, too. The fast boats from Water Dragon Stronghold should be waiting at the Zaoyang ferry, so you can entrust the letter to our household retainers.
findings.defect: Donghu Stronghold has already been annihilated, so Taekyung cannot warn it about the impending operation. His destination and the threatened location under discussion are Dongting Lake.
findings.rationale: The chapter repeatedly establishes Donghu Stronghold as one of the three destroyed strongholds. Retaining it here creates a direct continuity contradiction and obscures the warning that leads into the Dongting Lake disaster.
findings.replacement: Send word to Dongting Lake, too. The fast boats from Water Dragon Stronghold should be waiting at the Zaoyang ferry, so you can entrust the letter to our household retainers.

findings.current: Zhuge Gyun coordinates the Zhuge Clan’s intelligence with the Beggars’ Sect and Lower District Sect, while Taekyung warns Wudang and Donghu Stronghold.
findings.defect: The summary repeats the impossible claim that Taekyung warns the already-destroyed Donghu Stronghold.
findings.rationale: The summary should preserve the intended warning destination without propagating Chapter 456’s continuity error into later state.
findings.replacement: Zhuge Gyun coordinates the Zhuge Clan’s intelligence with the Beggars’ Sect and Lower District Sect, while Taekyung warns Wudang and Dongting Lake.

findings.current: “You have fifteen minutes from now. Both of you search as far as you can within that time. If you don’t find any survivors, come back.”
findings.defect: The visible Quest limit is 9 minutes 43 seconds, and the next paragraph explicitly says that searching beyond that limit would be meaningless. Giving the searchers fifteen minutes contradicts both facts.
findings.rationale: Nine minutes fits the displayed countdown and the subsequent rescue at 1 minute 12 seconds. The later line “Fifteen minutes. I’ll remember, Benefactor.” must likewise read “Nine minutes. I’ll remember, Benefactor.”
findings.replacement: “You have nine minutes from now. Both of you search as far as you can within that time. If you don’t find any survivors, come back.”

summary: One major continuity error is repeated in Chapter 456 and the checkpoint summary: Taekyung orders a warning sent to Donghu Stronghold after its annihilation, where context requires Dongting Lake. Chapter 457 also gives the searchers fifteen minutes despite a displayed limit of under ten minutes and immediately states that searching past that limit is pointless.
